title: pultenaea ferruginea var. deanei
intro: Pultenaea ferruginea var. deanei, commonly known as Deane's Bush Pea, is a shrub in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Deane's Bush Pea are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory compounds and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
